fullPassage:
Treasures for Three Gods

Important Norse Gods

Odin, who is the highest god, gave up his eye for wisdom.
Thor is Odin's son and the strongest god of all.
Frey, who is the god of the harvest, controls the weather.
Loki is a god who plays tricks on others.

Thor woke and knew immediately something was wrong. His wife's beautiful golden hair was gone. He knew only Loki could do such a terrible thing. Thor soon found Loki, who was drinking at home.
"You'd better undo what you did, or you'll be sorry," Thor said angrily to Loki.
Loki was scared. He promised that he would get golden hair for Thor's wife.

Loki knew only the sons of Ivaldi could make fine golden hair. He went to them and said, "I heard Brokk and his brother are the finest smiths. Is that true?"
"No, it is we who are the finest smiths," the sons of Ivaldi replied.

"They're making three treasures for Odin, Thor, and Frey," said Loki. "Do you think you can make treasures better than theirs?"
"Of course we can," they answered.
"O.K., then you should also make three treasures for them," said Loki. "The gods will decide on the best treasure."

Loki also told them that one of the treasures had to be golden hair. They went to work immediately.

Loki then went to see Brokk and his brother. "Ivaldi's sons are making three treasures for Odin, Thor, and Frey," said Loki. "I bet that you can never make treasures as fine as theirs."
Brokk became angry and accepted the challenge. He and his brother produced three treasures of their own.

Loki went to see the three gods with all the treasures. Brokk came along. Loki showed them the treasures from Ivaldi's sons. The first treasure was for Odin, who had only one eye. It was a spear that never missed its target.

The second treasure was a big ship that could turn into a piece of cloth. It was for Frey. The third treasure was for Thor. Loki showed Thor the flowing golden hair for his wife. Thor put the hair on his wife's head, and it took root and became real hair.

It was now Brokk's turn to show the gods his gifts. He gave Odin a gold arm ring that produced eight more gold rings every ninth night. Brokk then gave Frey a pig. It could pull his carriage faster than any horse.

"My third treasure is for you, Thor," said Brokk. "This is the hammer Mjolnir, which you'll love. If you throw it, it'll always come back to you. Moreover, nothing can ever break it."

It was an easy decision to choose the greatest treasure. It was Mjolnir that the three gods liked most. They thought the hammer would protect the gods from their enemies.
"Brokk and his brother," said Odin, "are the better smiths."
Brokk proved that Loki was wrong, and the three gods now had precious treasures.

questions.passage: Treasures for Three Gods Important Norse Gods Odin, who is the (A)[highest / lowest] god, gave up his eye for wisdom. Thor is Odin's son and the (B)[strongest / weakest] god of all. Frey, who is the god of the harvest, controls the weather. Loki is a god who plays (C)[tricks / favors] on others. Thor woke and knew immediately something was wrong. His wife's beautiful golden hair was gone. He knew only Loki could do such a terrible thing. Thor soon found Loki, who was drinking at home.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 가장 높은 신인 오딘은 지혜를 위해 눈을 포기했다. 토르는 모든 신 중 가장 강한 신이다. 로키는 다른 이들에게 장난을 치는 신이다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① lowest — strongest — tricks: (A) lowest는 '가장 낮은'으로 원문 highest와 반대.
✅ ② highest — strongest — tricks: 원문 그대로. 오딘은 가장 높은 신, 토르는 가장 강한 신, 로키는 장난치는 신.
❌ ③ highest — weakest — tricks: (B) weakest는 '가장 약한'으로 원문 strongest와 반대.
❌ ④ highest — strongest — favors: (C) favors는 '호의'로 원문 tricks(장난)와 반대.
det.tip: highest(가장 높은) ↔ lowest(가장 낮은). strongest(가장 강한) ↔ weakest(가장 약한). tricks(장난) ↔ favors(호의).

questions.passage: Thor woke and knew (A)[immediately / slowly] something was wrong. His wife's beautiful golden hair was gone. He knew only Loki could do such a (B)[terrible / wonderful] thing. Thor soon found Loki, who was drinking at home. "You'd better undo what you did, or you'll be sorry," Thor said angrily to Loki. Loki was (C)[scared / delighted]. He promised that he would get golden hair for Thor's wife. Loki knew only the sons of Ivaldi could make fine golden hair.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① slowly — terrible — delighted: (A) slowly는 원문 immediately와 반대.
❌ ② immediately — wonderful — scared: (B) wonderful은 원문 terrible과 반대.
✅ ③ immediately — terrible — scared: 원문 그대로. 즉시 알아챘고, 끔찍한 일이었고, 로키는 겁에 질렸다.
❌ ④ slowly — wonderful — delighted: (A)(B)(C) 모두 반대.
det.tip: immediately(즉시) ↔ slowly(천천히). terrible(끔찍한) ↔ wonderful(훌륭한). scared(겁먹은) ↔ delighted(기뻐하는).

questions.passage: The first treasure was for Odin, who had only one eye. It was a spear that never (A)[missed / hit] its target. The second treasure was a big ship that could turn into a piece of cloth. It was for Frey. The third treasure was for Thor. Loki showed Thor the (B)[flowing / tangled] golden hair for his wife. Thor put the hair on his wife's head, and it took root and became (C)[real / fake] hair.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① missed — flowing — real: 원문 그대로. 빗나가지 않는 창, 흘러내리는 머리카락, 진짜 머리카락.
❌ ② hit — flowing — fake: (A) hit은 '맞추다'로 never missed와 뉘앙스 달라짐, (C) fake는 반대.
❌ ③ missed — tangled — fake: (B)(C) 모두 반대.
❌ ④ hit — tangled — real: (A)(B) 모두 반대.
det.tip: miss(빗나가다) ↔ hit(맞추다). flowing(흘러내리는) ↔ tangled(엉킨). real(진짜) ↔ fake(가짜).

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.tip: tricks(장난) ↔ rewards(보상). play tricks on = ~에게 장난치다.

det.analysis:
✅ ① immediately: 즉시 알아챘으므로 적절.

✅ ③ terrible: 끔찍한 일 적절.
✅ ④ scared: 토르에게 혼날까 봐 겁먹은 것 적절.
det.tip: beautiful(아름다운) ↔ ugly(못생긴).

✅ ② faster: 어떤 말보다 빠르게 적절.
❌ ③ never: 원문은 always(항상). 망치는 던지면 항상 돌아오는 것이 장점이므로 never(절대 ~않다)는 부적절.

det.tip: always(항상) ↔ never(절대 ~않다). 원문: it'll always come back to you.

det.tip: promise = 약속하다. He promised that he would ~(~하겠다고 약속했다).

❌ ② accepted the challenge immediately: '도전을 즉시 수락하다'는 브로크의 행동이지 신들의 행동이 아님.
✅ ③ decide on the best treasure: 원문 그대로. 로키가 신들이 최고의 보물을 결정할 것이라 말함.
❌ ④ make fine golden hair for them: '금빛 머리카락을 만들다'는 이발디 아들들의 행동.
det.tip: decide on = ~을 결정하다. The gods will decide on the best treasure.

ch: make fine golden hair for them
